simple: Check Point Threat Exposure Management (Exposure Prioritization & Remediation, formerly Veriti) — part of Check Point Exposure Management: an agentless platform that pulls vulnerability and configuration data from your existing security tools (70+ integrations: firewalls, WAFs, EDR, vulnerability scanners, CNAPP) and safely fixes exposures through those tools — checking business impact before any change, via API or ITSM tickets. Licensed by number of network security controls (firewalls, WAFs) and assets. The IoC Management package works with security controls from any supported vendor. Indicator-of-compromise management: adding, changing and removing IoCs on security controls manually and in bulk, spreading IoCs found by one control to all others and automatically ingesting indicators from feeds (commercial, open-source, government, proprietary); a private exposure map. Configuration assessment and vulnerability work are in other packages.
